verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside Pika that users can delegate tasks to. Pika MCP lets external agents such as ChatGPT and Claude call Pika, and the line "without leaving your conversation" refers to that external-agent flow. This is an integration for other agents, not an in-product assistant. The task-specific apps (Short Film, Product Ad) are single-purpose generators, not a delegating assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
